resources.string: Export a bounded snapshot of existing technical ERROR logs, filtered again before export. Only time, error module/code, Android API and HTTP status are included. No browsing history, URLs, paths, cookies or tokens. Nothing is uploaded automatically; skipping export does not affect the app.

Choose a destination in the system file picker. The selected file provider may sync this file to the cloud. Export writes once; provider writes are not guaranteed atomic. If cancelled or failed, a partial or empty destination file may remain. Check it in that provider; the app will not delete or retry it.
Export starts only when you tap the button.
Cancelling. Waiting for the current provider operation to finish and close; a partial file may remain.
No eligible technical ERROR records to export.
Snapshot written and the output stream closed successfully.
Export failed. If you selected a destination, an empty or partial file may remain. Check it in the selected file provider before trying again.
Export cancelled. If you selected a destination, an empty or partial file may remain.
Export timed out. No further writes will be started; a previously admitted provider operation may still finish. Check the destination for an empty or partial file.
An earlier diagnostic operation has not confirmed resource release. No new export was started. You can leave this page and try again later.
Resource release is not yet confirmed. New exports are isolated in this app process; this does not mean the write was withdrawn or the file removed. You can still leave this page.
